types.note: An inbox capture (the input organ): a source clipped into the daily log. Keyed inbox/<ts>, tagged `log:<date>` and linked `on` the day's `log:<date>` fact. `value.captured` is the YYYY-MM-DD (the lit daily-log view opens on it); `value.day` is a ref to `log:<date>` that projects the `on` edge (ADR-0003 derived edge). Captured from the PWA (as the signed-in user) or the `@c15r/input.capture` tool (organ path).

schema.content: string — markdown body (a checkbox link + optional clipped quote)
schema.captured: string — YYYY-MM-DD day it was captured
schema.title: string? — source title
schema.day: ref? — the daily log (log:<date>) this capture is filed under

fields.name: day
fields.description: the daily log (log:<date>) this capture is filed under
